The coast — Obhur & North Jeddah

Villa design in Obhur & North Jeddah

A waterfront plot and a plot between neighbours call for different plans. We start with the view you want to keep, the sides exposed to the street and the time of day you like to sit outside. Those details help us place a terrace or courtyard where you will use it.

Request a free call WhatsApp

Where should the terrace go?

If the view opens up on an upper floor, we look at placing a terrace beside a room you use every day. If neighbouring windows overlook the boundary wall, we study where the seating can go and how high a screen needs to be from a seated person’s point of view.

Street and courtyard at Montashiri Villa

The project page shows the villa first from the street, then from inside. Planted terraces rise above the stone street facade. In the living room, the seating faces broad courtyard windows. In the kitchen, a glazed door opens towards planting.

Frequently asked questions about private villa design

Do you have experience with Obhur plots specifically?

Yes. Montashiri Villa is a studio design for Obhur. Its project page shows renderings of the street facade, living room and kitchen.

How do you protect privacy on an open waterfront?

We identify which directions overlook the seating area, then study its orientation and the position of side screens to preserve the view you value.

Do you design villas in North Jeddah generally?

Yes. Tell us the district and approximate plot size when you get in touch. If you have photos taken from the plot towards the street and neighbours, we can review them on the first call.
